cold.headline: Demand changed. Which lots need a review?
cold.body: Before replanning, check the product, planning period and partner lot reports.

cards.headline: Demand changed. Which lots matter?
cards.body: Identify the outsourced lots linked to the changed demand before discussing the plan with production partners.

cards.headline: Start with product and planning period.
cards.body: Agree which product, planning period and outsourced lots the demand change concerns.

cards.headline: When was this lot status recorded?
cards.body: Check the report time and source alongside lot status before using it in a planning discussion.

cards.headline: What needs confirmation from the partner?
cards.body: List missing information and who will confirm it with each production partner before discussing changes.

cards.headline: Give replanning a shared basis.
cards.body: Bring scope, report source and confirmation owners into the same planning discussion.

ui.title: Demand changes: a shared basis for the next plan

en.reader_question: Which product and planning period does the demand change concern? Which outsourced lots need review? When were partner reports recorded, what is their source, and who will confirm missing information before discussing the next plan?

cold.headline: 需求预测变了，先看哪些批次？
cold.body: 调整计划前，先核对产品、计划期间与合作伙伴的批次报告。

cards.headline: 需求预测变了，哪些批次相关？
cards.body: 先明确需求变化涉及哪些委外批次，再与生产合作伙伴讨论计划。

cards.headline: 先核对产品与计划期间。
cards.body: 明确需求变化涉及的产品、计划期间与委外批次范围。

cards.headline: 这个批次状态何时记录？
cards.body: 结合报告时间与来源核对批次状态，再用于计划讨论。

cards.headline: 还需向合作伙伴确认什么？
cards.body: 列出缺失信息，以及负责向各生产合作伙伴确认的人员，再讨论调整。

cards.headline: 让计划调整有共同依据。
cards.body: 把批次范围、报告来源与确认责任放在同一场计划讨论中。
